STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_02618_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_02618_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_02618 (
    input wire clock,
    input wire reset,
    input wire pulso, 
    input wire tick,
    output reg zera_tick,
    output reg conta_tick,
    output reg zera_bcd,
    output reg conta_bcd,
    output reg pronto
);

    reg [2:0] Eatual, Eprox;

    parameter inicial    = 3'b000;
    parameter prepara    = 3'b001;
    parameter conta      = 3'b010;
    parameter conta_cm   = 3'b011;
    parameter fim        = 3'b100;

    always @(posedge clock or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset)
            Eatual <= inicial;
        else
            Eatual <= Eprox;
    end

    always @(Eatual or pulso or tick) begin
        case (Eatual)
            inicial    : Eprox = pulso ? prepara : inicial;
            prepara    : Eprox = pulso ? conta : fim;
            conta      : Eprox = pulso ? (tick ? conta_cm : conta) : fim;
            conta_cm   : Eprox = pulso ? conta : fim;
            fim        : Eprox = inicial;
        endcase
    end

    always @(Eatual) begin
        zera_tick  = (Eatual == prepara)  ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        zera_bcd   = (Eatual == prepara)  ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        conta_tick = (Eatual == conta || Eatual == conta_cm) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        conta_bcd  = (Eatual == conta_cm) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
        pronto     = (Eatual == fim)      ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    end

endmodule
